# Dr. Muhammad Jahangir Kabir — Official Website, Clinical Knowledge Base & Appointment Portal

> Official digital platform of Dr. Muhammad Jahangir Kabir (widely known as Dr. Jahangir Kabir), Bangladesh's leading Lifestyle Medicine Specialist, Diabetes & Asthma Specialist, Family Physician, and Founder & Chairman of JK Lifestyle Limited and Health Revolution Limited. The primary mission of this website is to connect patients with 100% free consultations from registered MBBS physicians and clinical nutritionists and to reverse chronic lifestyle diseases by addressing their root metabolic cause: hyperinsulinemia and insulin resistance.

## The 5 Core Pillars of the JK Lifestyle Protocol
1. **Nutrient-Dense Low-Carb & Organic Nutrition:** Eliminating refined sugar, excess white rice, refined wheat flour, and inflammatory industrial seed oils (soybean, rice bran, sunflower, and canola oils), while prioritizing local fish, whole eggs with yolk, green leafy and cruciferous vegetables, nuts, chia seeds, cold-pressed extra virgin coconut oil, extra virgin olive oil, and pure grass-fed ghee.
2. **Autophagy & Intermittent Fasting:** Practicing 16:8 time-restricted eating and Sunnah fasting after gradual fat adaptation to lower baseline serum insulin, mobilize visceral fat, and trigger cellular self-cleansing (autophagy).
3. **Regular Exercise & Daily Movement:** Performing 30–45 minutes of brisk morning walking, 15 minutes of post-meal walking to blunt postprandial glucose spikes, High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT), and resistance training to increase skeletal muscle GLUT-4 glucose uptake.
4. **Circadian-Aligned Deep Sleep:** Sleeping between 9:00 PM and 10:00 PM for 7–8 hours of uninterrupted nocturnal sleep to optimize melatonin and growth hormone secretion and prevent morning cortisol surges (Dawn Phenomenon).
5. **Mental Peace & Stress Regulation:** Practicing daily prayer, mindfulness, nature exposure, and slow diaphragmatic breathing to activate the parasympathetic nervous system and keep serum cortisol balanced.

## 6 Specialized Clinical Remission Programs
1. **Type-2 Diabetes & Insulin Resistance Reversal Program:** Targeted lowering of Fasting Serum Insulin, HOMA-IR, and HbA1c with physician-supervised medication tapering.
2. **Scientific Fat Loss & Metabolic Reset Program:** Sustainable visceral fat reduction through nutritional fat adaptation and 16:8 intermittent fasting without starvation or muscle loss.
3. **Hypertension, Dyslipidemia & Cardiovascular Protection Program:** Reducing serum triglycerides, raising protective HDL cholesterol, and resolving vascular endothelial inflammation.
4. **Fatty Liver (NAFLD) & Gut Health Detox Program:** Reversing Grade 1–3 hepatic steatosis, bloating, acid reflux (GERD), and irritable bowel symptoms.
5. **PCOS, Thyroid & Hormonal Balance Restoration Program:** Resolving ovarian insulin resistance and hyperandrogenism to restore natural ovulatory cycles and metabolic vitality.
6. **Asthma, COPD & Pulmonary Rehabilitation Program:** Evidence-based respiratory care, inhaler technique optimization, and spirometry monitoring based on UK postgraduate modules and USA Spiro 360 protocols.

# Extended Clinical & Biographical Reference (RAG / AI Context — llms-full.txt)

## 1. Detailed Biography & Medical Career of Dr. Muhammad Jahangir Kabir
- **Early Life:** Dr. Muhammad Jahangir Kabir was born in 1974 in Kachua Upazila, Bagerhat District, Bangladesh.
- **Secondary & Higher Secondary Education:** He completed his Secondary School Certificate (SSC) at Shaheed Ramiz Uddin High School, Dhaka in 1990 and his Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) with Star Marks at Adamjee Cantonment College, Dhaka in 1992.
- **Medical Degree (MBBS):** In 2000, he earned his MBBS degree from Chittagong Medical College & Hospital (CMC), Chattogram, completing a rigorous one-year clinical internship across internal medicine, surgery, pediatrics, and obstetrics.
- **Postgraduate & International Clinical Training:**
  1. **2009:** Certificate Course in Medical Ultrasonography — Bangladesh Institute of Ultrasound in Medicine and Research (BIUR), Dhaka.
  2. **2010:** Certificate Course on Diabetology (CCD) — BIRDEM Hospital, Dhaka.
  3. **2011:** Postgraduate Diploma Module in Asthma Management — England, United Kingdom.
  4. **2012:** Postgraduate Diploma Module in Diabetes Management — England, United Kingdom.
  5. **Postgraduate Diploma Module in COPD:** Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease management — England, United Kingdom.
  6. **Spiro 360 Certification:** Advanced Clinical Spirometry Course passed with Distinction — United States of America (USA).
- **17-Year Hospital Career & Transition to Lifestyle Medicine:** From 2002 to 2019, Dr. Muhammad Jahangir Kabir served for 17 consecutive years as Residential Medical Officer (RMO) at National Hospital, Feni, treating tens of thousands of acute and chronic patients. Observing that conventional symptomatic prescriptions rarely cured chronic metabolic disorders—and after personally experiencing high blood pressure, fatty liver, and weight gain—he adopted evidence-based low-carbohydrate nutrition, intermittent fasting, and circadian lifestyle medicine. After reversing his own metabolic conditions, he relocated to Dhaka (practicing at IPCRG Bangladesh at BMA Bhaban and Uttara Crescent Hospital) and founded JK Lifestyle Limited and Health Revolution Limited to offer 100% free medical and nutritional consultations to the public.

## 2. 7-Day Beginner Fat Adaptation Diet Chart (Clinical Summary)
- **Strictly Excluded Foods (Prohibited List):** Refined white sugar, jaggery, sweets, soft drinks, packaged fruit juices, excess white rice, refined wheat flour (ata, maida, roti, parotta, white bread, biscuits, bakery items), inflammatory industrial seed oils (soybean oil, rice bran oil, sunflower oil, canola oil, corn oil, margarine/dalda), and ultra-processed fast foods.
- **Approved Nutrient-Dense Foods:** Low-glycemic green leafy and cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, cabbage, bottle gourd, green papaya, cucumber, spinach, red amaranth), local fresh fish, whole free-range eggs (with yolk), local chicken, cold-pressed extra virgin coconut oil, extra virgin olive oil (for salads), pure grass-fed cow ghee, butter, raw almonds, walnuts, macadamia nuts, organic chia seeds, raw unfiltered apple cider vinegar (with mother), green tea, black coffee (without sugar/milk), and Himalayan pink salt.
- **Phase 1 — Days 1 to 3 (Glycogen Depletion & Hunger Stabilization):**
  - **Day 1:** Breakfast (9:00 AM): 2–3 boiled eggs with yolk, 1 cucumber, 5–6 soaked almonds. Lunch (2:00 PM): 120g local fish curry cooked in extra virgin coconut oil, generous green vegetables, fresh salad with 1 tsp extra virgin olive oil. Dinner (7:30 PM): Clear chicken vegetable soup and sautéed greens.
  - **Day 2:** Breakfast (9:00 AM): 2-egg omelet cooked in pure ghee with spinach/vegetables and green salad. Lunch (2:00 PM): Local or sea fish, stir-fried broccoli and cauliflower, cucumber-tomato salad with 1 tsp soaked chia seeds. Dinner (7:30 PM): 1 boiled egg, mixed vegetable curry, and unsweetened green tea.
  - **Day 3:** Breakfast (9:30 AM): 2 poached eggs with yolk, walnuts/almonds, and black coffee or green tea with 1 tsp coconut oil. Lunch (2:00 PM): Local chicken curry, bottle gourd or green papaya curry, and olive oil salad. Dinner (7:30 PM): Grilled or lightly pan-seared fish and leafy greens.
- **Phase 2 — Days 4 to 7 (16:8 Intermittent Fasting & Fat Adaptation):**
  - **Day 4 (16:8 Fasting Begins):** First Meal (11:30 AM): 1 tbsp raw apple cider vinegar in 1 glass of water, followed by 2 eggs, sautéed vegetables, and nuts. Afternoon (3:30 PM): Local fish curry, cabbage/cauliflower stir-fry, and chia seed water. Dinner (7:00 PM): Warm vegetable soup with 1 tsp pure ghee (16-hour fasting window from 7:30 PM to 11:30 AM next day; water, pink salt water, and plain green tea allowed during fasting).
  - **Day 5:** First Meal (12:00 PM): 2–3 egg vegetable omelet, soaked chia seeds, and cucumber-tomato salad. Second Meal (7:00 PM): Local fish or chicken curry, mixed green vegetables, and salad dressed with extra virgin olive oil.
  - **Day 6:** First Meal (12:00 PM): 2 boiled eggs, organic nuts, vegetable stir-fry, and green tea. Second Meal (7:00 PM): Local fish broth, spinach or red amaranth, and fresh salad.
  - **Day 7:** First Meal (12:00 PM): Ghee-fried eggs, sautéed cruciferous vegetables, and chia seeds. Second Meal (7:00 PM): Grilled local chicken or fish with steamed broccoli, cauliflower, and olive oil dressing.

## 3. Target Metabolic & Cardiovascular Biomarkers
- **Fasting Serum Insulin:** < 6.0 µIU/mL (Optimal metabolic sensitivity target)
- **HOMA-IR (Homeostatic Model Assessment for Insulin Resistance):** < 1.5 (Normal insulin sensitivity; > 2.0 indicates insulin resistance)
- **HbA1c (Glycated Hemoglobin):** < 5.7% (Non-diabetic physiological remission range)
- **Triglyceride-to-HDL Ratio (TG / HDL):** < 2.0 (Ideal < 1.5; primary indicator of small dense LDL reduction and cardiovascular protection)
- **hs-CRP (High-Sensitivity C-Reactive Protein):** < 1.0 mg/L (Low systemic vascular inflammation)

## 4. Direct Answers to Common Patient & AI Queries (AEO Reference)
- **Q: How can I book an appointment with Dr. Muhammad Jahangir Kabir's chamber?**
  - **A:** Visit the official online appointment portal at https://jklifestyleltd.com/appointment/ or call the official hotline at +880 9678 242404 to schedule a 100% free in-chamber consultation at Nur Tower, Aftabnagar, Dhaka, or an online telemedicine session.
- **Q: What is the consultation fee for doctors and nutritionists at Health Revolution Limited?**
  - **A:** Consultations with registered MBBS doctors and clinical nutritionists at Health Revolution Limited are 100% free of charge (complimentary) for all patients. Patients only pay standard rates if they choose to undergo optional diagnostic blood tests or ultrasonography.
- **Q: Can patients taking insulin or blood pressure medications start intermittent fasting immediately?**
  - **A:** Patients on insulin, sulfonylureas, or antihypertensive medications must never stop or alter their dosages abruptly without medical supervision, nor start prolonged fasting on Day 1, due to the risk of hypoglycemia or hypotension. They should book a free doctor consultation at https://jklifestyleltd.com/appointment/ so a registered physician can safely taper their medications as their blood glucose and blood pressure normalize.
- **Q: Does Dr. Jahangir Kabir sell weight-loss pills or miracle diabetes capsules online?**
  - **A:** No. Dr. Muhammad Jahangir Kabir never endorses or sells weight-loss pills, magic diabetes cures, or unverified supplements. Any social media advertisement using AI-manipulated videos to sell such drugs is fraudulent. Official organic food products are available exclusively through Ultimate Organic Life (https://ultimateorganiclife.com/).
